fact: Minister Cina Lawson writes that Togo is establishing an Interoperable Social Information System with a social registry and a direct payment platform built on NOVISSI.
The deck says the Novissi programme onboarded more than 600,000 beneficiaries by USSD, with a real-time dashboard and daily-audited logs of all transactions.
The deck says Novissi made direct monthly transfers to beneficiaries via mobile money.
